known_limitations: Deterministic embedding, rerank and token benchmarks prove contract mechanics, not production model quality.
Exact provider token, cost and cache-hit values remain unavailable without provider receipts and are never rendered as zero.
Source release is the only distribution channel in this increment; no container image, npm package or binary distribution exists.
Tag signing, SBOM generation and build provenance attestations are not produced and are not claimed.
Historical v0.0.1-bootstrap notes and the internal V0.1 Foundation history remain as originally accepted.
